storyPoints.title: Běžné dodávky
storyPoints.description: Leden a únor: dodavatel SUP-001 dodává převážně včas, zpoždění jsou řídká a krátká.

storyPoints.title: Dodavatel začíná zpožďovat dodávky
storyPoints.description: Od března dodavatel SUP-001 často zpožďuje dodávky a zpoždění jsou delší. Zásoby jeho produktů docházejí, přibývá čekajících objednávek, stížností a storen.

expectations.description: Podíl zpožděných dodávek (7 a více dní) produktů dodavatele SUP-001 vzroste.
expectations.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(sd.order_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-15' AND CAST(sd.order_date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-03-01' THEN 'before' WHEN CAST(sd.order_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-03-15' AND CAST(sd.order_date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-06-01' THEN 'after' END AS period, AVG(CASE WHEN date_diff('day', CAST(sd.order_date AS DATE), CAST(sd.delivered_date AS DATE)) >= 7 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS value FROM main.supplier_delivery sd WHERE sd.supplier_id = 'SUP-001' GROUP BY 1 HAVING period IS NOT NULL

expectations.description: Počet čekajících objednávek za den u produktů dodavatele SUP-001 vzroste.
expectations.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-15' AND CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-03-01' THEN 'before' WHEN CAST(date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-03-15' AND CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-06-01' THEN 'after' END AS period, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS n FROM main.customer_order GROUP BY 1), e AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(b.date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-15' AND CAST(b.date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-03-01' THEN 'before' WHEN CAST(b.date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-03-15' AND CAST(b.date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-06-01' THEN 'after' END AS period, COUNT(*) AS c FROM main.order_backorder b JOIN main.product p ON p.id = b.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = 'SUP-001' GROUP BY 1) SELECT d.period AS period, CAST(COALESCE(e.c, 0) AS DOUBLE) / d.n AS value FROM d LEFT JOIN e ON e.period = d.period WHERE d.period IS NOT NULL

expectations.description: Počet stížností za den na objednávky produktů dodavatele SUP-001 vzroste.
expectations.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-15' AND CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-03-01' THEN 'before' WHEN CAST(date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-03-15' AND CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-06-01' THEN 'after' END AS period, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS n FROM main.customer_order GROUP BY 1), e AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(c.date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-15' AND CAST(c.date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-03-01' THEN 'before' WHEN CAST(c.date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-03-15' AND CAST(c.date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-06-01' THEN 'after' END AS period, COUNT(*) AS c FROM main.complaint c JOIN main.customer_order o ON o.id = c.order_id JOIN main.product p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = 'SUP-001' GROUP BY 1) SELECT d.period AS period, CAST(COALESCE(e.c, 0) AS DOUBLE) / d.n AS value FROM d LEFT JOIN e ON e.period = d.period WHERE d.period IS NOT NULL

expectations.description: Počet stornovaných objednávek za den u produktů dodavatele SUP-001 vzroste.
expectations.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-15' AND CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-03-01' THEN 'before' WHEN CAST(date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-03-15' AND CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-06-01' THEN 'after' END AS period, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS n FROM main.customer_order GROUP BY 1), e AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(x.date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-15' AND CAST(x.date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-03-01' THEN 'before' WHEN CAST(x.date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-03-15' AND CAST(x.date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-06-01' THEN 'after' END AS period, COUNT(*) AS c FROM main.order_cancellation x JOIN main.customer_order o ON o.id = x.order_id JOIN main.product p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = 'SUP-001' GROUP BY 1) SELECT d.period AS period, CAST(COALESCE(e.c, 0) AS DOUBLE) / d.n AS value FROM d LEFT JOIN e ON e.period = d.period WHERE d.period IS NOT NULL

expectations.description: Kontrola: počet objednávek za den u produktů nezasaženého dodavatele SUP-002 zůstává stabilní (poptávka se nemění).
expectations.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-15' AND CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-03-01' THEN 'before' WHEN CAST(date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-03-15' AND CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-06-01' THEN 'after' END AS period, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS n FROM main.customer_order GROUP BY 1), e AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(o.date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-15' AND CAST(o.date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-03-01' THEN 'before' WHEN CAST(o.date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-03-15' AND CAST(o.date AS DATE) < DATE '2025-06-01' THEN 'after' END AS period, COUNT(*) AS c FROM main.customer_order o JOIN main.product p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = 'SUP-002' GROUP BY 1) SELECT d.period AS period, CAST(COALESCE(e.c, 0) AS DOUBLE) / d.n AS value FROM d LEFT JOIN e ON e.period = d.period WHERE d.period IS NOT NULL
